title: Enrolment
description: The POST to <url>/.well-known/qory-enrolment, which assigns a new access key its id, or redeems a run code for a run's run key and the run's documents, its 201 answers and its signed refusals: the request's body is $defs/request, the 201 to an access key's code $defs/answer, the 201 to a run code $defs/run_answer, a signed 409's or 429's body $defs/refusal, and a document is one of the four. The request carries no access key id and no request signature; the code and the proof authenticate it. Each 201 and every signed refusal are signed under the server's key, the first line of the signed answer being the enrolment answers' domain line, qory-enrol-answer-ed25519-v1, and line 3 the request's proof exactly as sent. The server checks the key and verifies the proof under it before it signs anything. Each 201 and every signed refusal list the server's keys, so a machine without a pin verifies either under the key its code's first fingerprint names. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object. Every binary value is base64url without padding.

server_keys.description: The server's signing keys: the current one, and during a rotation the next one after it. The machine verifies the answer or the refusal under the entry whose fingerprint the code carries first, and from a 201 pins only the entries whose fingerprints the code carries.

request.title: Enrolment request
request.description: The body of the enrolment request. proof is the Ed25519 signature under the new key of five lines joined by a line feed, with none after the last: qory-enrol-ed25519-v1, code, public_key, name, and timestamp in canonical decimal.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses another version, 400 invalid_request.

code.description: The enrolment code in its normalised form: a prefix in lower case and 26 Crockford base32 characters in upper case, then a dot and the fingerprint of the server's public key, and during a rotation of the server's key a second dot and the next key's fingerprint. A fingerprint is base64url(SHA-256(raw public key)[:16]). The prefix names the kind of key the code enrols: qecn_ a node's, qecp_ a node pool's, qecg_ a gateway's and qeci_ an integration's (node_kind adapter), and the 201's node_kind is the prefix's kind. qecr_ is a run code: it enrols no access key and redeems a run's run key, and its 201 is $defs/run_answer. A code whose prefix names another kind than its node's is unknown to the server, which answers it 401 as any unknown code; a code with any other prefix is malformed, and the server refuses it as an invalid request, 400.

name.description: The access key's name for people, by default the host name of the machine that enrols it.

public_key.description: The new access key's raw Ed25519 public key.

timestamp.description: The machine's clock, in decimal seconds since the Unix epoch. The server accepts it within 300 seconds of its clock. It is a JSON integer below 2^53, with no sign, fraction or exponent; the server checks the form when it decodes.

proof.description: The proof of possession: the Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes, under the new key.

answer.title: Enrolment answer
answer.description: The 201 answer: the new access key's id, its node, node pool, gateway or adapter, its stored-secrets flag and the server's public keys. The access key is active from the 201 on. Every member is required.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

access_key_id.description: The access key's id: ak_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

node_id.description: The id of the access key's node, nd_, node pool, np_, gateway, ng_, or adapter, na_, followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

node_kind.description: node for an nd_ id, pool for an np_ id, gateway for an ng_ id, adapter for an na_ id.

stored_secrets.description: The access key's stored-secrets flag, fixed when the key is created.

run_answer.title: Run code answer
run_answer.description: The 201 to a run code, qecr_: the run's id, its run key, the server's public keys and the run's documents. Every member is required. The redemption makes no access key. A run code is valid for 15 minutes and is used once: a redemption by another public key after the first is 401, and a retry by the same public key within the 15 minutes, while the run's dispatch lives, gets the same members, the same run_id, run_key, apiary_public_key and documents, signed over the retry's proof. The run key's issued is the time of the code's first redemption, not the time the code was made, and its attach_by is 600 seconds after issued. The answer is at most 1 MiB: Forager reads at most 1 MiB of the body of an answer to a run code, and counts a longer body as unsigned, answer_unsigned. The answer is signed as the 201 to an access key's code is, and the signature covers the whole body, documents included. The machine verifies it under the listed key whose fingerprint is the code's first, then verifies run_key as the gateway does, under the listed key whose fingerprint is in the code and is the run key's signer, and checks that the run key's run_id is run_id.

version.description: The document format. For a version it does not read, Forager returns an error.

run_id.description: The run's id, a UUID in the canonical lower-case form: the run_id of the run key's payload.

run_key.description: The run's run key, run-key.schema.json: qrk_, the payload in base64url without padding, a dot and the signature. The machine keeps it in memory and passes it to the session as RemoteGateway.RunKey, and writes it to no file and no environment variable.

documents.description: The run's documents: a JSON object, whose schema is documents.schema.json of qoryai/integrations, https://qory.dev/contracts/run/v1/documents.schema.json. Forager checks that documents is an object, reads none of its members, and passes it to the caller byte for byte as the answer contains it. A documents member that is not an object, null included, is refused.

refusal.title: Enrolment refusal
refusal.description: The body of a signed 409 or 429 at enrolment: key_invalid, a 409 for a key already enrolled, a revoked one included; key_limit, a 409 for a node, node pool or adapter that already holds two keys; or rate_limited, a 429 per code, for too many attempts with one code. It lists apiary_public_key, the same list in the same order as a 201 at that moment, current key first and during a rotation the next key after it, so the machine verifies the refusal as it verifies the 201: under the entry whose fingerprint its code carries first. A refusal sent unsigned, the 401, the 409 key_invalid to a key the checks refuse or a proof that does not verify under it, and every answer before the code is accepted, lists no key, and a machine acts on none by its status.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns, when it concerns any.
